name: local_document_ingest
description: Process desktop-uploaded local folder files with OpenClaw document understanding plus deterministic prepare/apply helpers for file validation, context extraction, source archival, Gitea page writes, and catalog/index maintenance.
input: Research KB backend local_folder task payload JSON from the payload file named in the OpenClaw message.
output: prepare emits local-document analysis context; OpenClaw writes pages.json; validate-pages checks JSON/path/sourceItemKeys/entity coverage before any KB write; apply archives source files under source_files/local_folder, writes pages/catalog/index to Gitea, and writes a resultFile JSON envelope with a boolean success field.
